title: ArXiv: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
description: Abstract: The current alignment tuning paradigm for Large Language Models (LLMs) prioritizes surface-level behaviors -- fluency, safety, and tonal consistency. While effective for casual chat, this thesis argue...

ko.title: 표면적 정렬을 넘어: 대형 언어 모델의 상황 이해와 생성 제어 메커니즘 접목
ko.hook: 단순 말투 및 안전성 조율을 넘어 LLM의 내부 상황 이해 및 정밀한 생성 제어 모델링 연구
key_takeaways: 기존 정렬(Alignment) 방식의 표면적 행동 제약 한계 지적
LLM의 심층적 상황 이해(Situational Understanding)를 고도화하는 방법론 제안
상황 맥락에 맞춰 답변 생성을 정밀하게 제어할 수 있는 가이던스 체계 구축

en.title: Beyond Surface Alignment: Grounding the Dynamics of Situational Understanding and Generative Control in LLMs
en.hook: Moving beyond surface-level safety tuning to achieve deep situational awareness and precise generative control in LLMs.
key_takeaways: Critiques the limitations of conventional alignment focused on surface-level fluency and tone
Proposes a framework to ground deep situational understanding inside LLMs
Enhances precise generative control based on contextual situational awareness

zh.title: 超越表面对齐：在大语言模型中构建情境理解与生成控制的动态机制
zh.hook: 超越表层安全与语调微调，针对LLM深层情境理解与精确生成控制的研究
key_takeaways: 指出现有聚焦于表层流畅度与安抚语调的对齐方法的局限
提出增强LLM内部深层情境理解（Situational Understanding）的方法论
构建基于具体上下文情境进行精确生成控制的机制
